instruction:
You are tasked with designing a verilog module that will perform a bitwise XOR operation on two 8-bit input values. The module should have two input ports, A and B, each 8 bits wide, and one output port, Y, also 8 bits wide. The module should also have a reset input, RST, which when set to 1, should reset the output value Y to all zeroes. The module should be named "xor_8bit".

Write the verilog code for the "xor_8bit" module that meets the above requirements.
original_rtl:
module xor_8bit (
   input [7:0] A,
   input [7:0] B,
   input RST,
   output reg [7:0] Y
);

   always @(*) begin
      if (RST == 1) begin
         Y <= 8'b0;
      end else begin
         Y <= A ^ B;
      end
   end

endmodule
